## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] I reviewed the complete diff.
- [ ] I checked representative mobile and desktop widths.
- [ ] Keyboard focus, labels, link purpose, and contrast remain accessible.
- [ ] I did not submit a live form or create an appointment during testing.
- [ ] I added no patient information, credentials, tokens, or real test-contact data.
- [ ] Protected-content changes, if any, are intentional and explained above.
